gaps.sentence: ___ contrast to her sister, she loves publicity.
___ any rate, we still have enough time.
gaps.explanation: 'At any rate' = whatever else is true.

gaps.sentence: I did it ___ my own initiative — nobody asked me.
gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.

gaps.sentence: The two reports differ ___ several important respects.
She's ___ charge of the whole marketing department.
He stayed ___ touch with every colleague he'd ever had.
We're ___ the impression that the offer had expired.
gaps.explanation: 'under the impression that…' = believing, often wrongly.

gaps.sentence: They kept the negotiation ___ wraps until the deal was signed.
gaps.explanation: 'keep something under wraps' = keep it secret.
